reason: Lint: RecoveryScreen has no suppression left. Its other-tab subscription listed only [shownText] and hid a react-hooks/exhaustive-deps warning (reread read but not listed); reread is now listed. It is the boot module's reader and never changes, so the subscription still lives exactly as before: one storage listener while the screen is open, renewed when the text it shows changes, none after Try again or the temporary session. Three new unreadable-autosave tests pin it: another tab writing a readable diagram and then the first text back shows the unreadable screen with its changed note again, and the same change under the discard confirmation closes it (both failed with a handler that kept the first text); and the screen's own storage listeners, told apart by the stack that added them, are 1 while open, 0 after Try again and after the temporary session, and 1 again after a reload (it failed with a subscription that never unsubscribes). Hidden warnings under suppressions 13 -> 12, all in ReviewOverlay. The warning cap is unchanged at 50. #625 item 5.
